verdict.rationale: The evidence pack includes only generic titles for APM/tracing (datadog-docs-23) and Log Management (datadog-docs-13) with no specific documentation of trace sampling rate configuration, retention-tier selection (e.g., indexed vs. flex/frozen logs), or volume-based cost controls. Without concrete evidence of sampling/retention mechanisms, this axis cannot be credited despite being a plausible capability for an observability platform.
